messages:
sam_sales: Hey team — new POC for NovaHealth. They signed the order form but legal flagged MSA/DPA redlines and a KMS/HSM requirement. Need quick path for signature & KMS acceptance. Can we do an addendum? @mia_legal @owen_eng

mia_legal: @sam_sales can you paste the redline summary? is this customer insisting on HSM-backed key control or just KMS integration?

sam_sales: They require customer-managed keys (HSM) + SOC2 attestation. Redlines: clause 7.2 (data encryption), add subproc list + HSM appendix. Pricing note: POC committed credits ~ $20k. They want a 30-day SLA for latency-sensitive endpoints.

mia_legal: we can do a DPA addendum for HSM but need review from security and infra. SLA 30d is ok for POC if we scope throughput — need to cap RPS. I'll draft addendum.

owen_eng: HSM in POC: we don't currently support customer HSM for Hosted. We can support in Dedicated or Private. For Hosted we can offer envelope encryption with customer KMS (bring-your-own KMS via AWS/GCP) but not HSM. Options: 1) Dedicated with HSM 2) BYOK with compromise on HSM. @marcus_se can validate latency impact.

marcus_se: latency-wise Dedicated with pinned GPU nodes meets 30-day SLA for the POC. For small scale we can reserve a pool. Need to confirm throughput. What's expected QPS?

sam_sales: Start with 5 rps, burst to 20 for short tests. Billing: they want net45 on POC. @ben_finance is that doable?

ben_finance: Net45 on POC needs sales manager signoff due to cashflow. We can do net30 standard; net45 needs approval. Suggest prepay credits to reduce risk.

mia_legal: Drafted a DPA addendum, attaching snippet below:

```text
Addendum: Customer KMS/HSM
1) For Dedicated/Private deployments, Customer may provide an HSM-backed key.
2) For Hosted deployment, Redwood will support BYOK via cloud KMS only; HSM support unavailable.
3) Security audits: Redwood will provide SOC2 Type II report on request.
```

mia_legal: Can someone confirm we can attach this addendum to the order form and proceed to countersignature?

owen_eng: Confirm production: Dedicated + HSM is feasible. We'll need 2 days to spin the pool and a config change. No expected code changes. I can approve timeline.

sam_sales: Great — I'll update order form and route to customer's legal. Routing: who should sign on our side? @ceo or delegated? Suggest @evan_ops for countersignature.

ben_finance: Evan is fine for commercial countersign; for MSA/DPA legal countersignature will be mia_legal.

sam_sales: Ok routing plan: Customer signs order form + DPA addendum -> send to evan_ops (commercial) and mia_legal (legal). I'll also propose prepay credits 50% to get net45 concession.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: reserved-dedicated-pool-novahealth in 48h, approver: owen_eng

sam_sales: Thanks all — I'll proceed and ping if legal redlines change. :thumbsup:
